test_title: PYST 55: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight line, facing the north.

A sits second from one of the extreme ends of the line. Only two people sit between A and C. B sits to the immediate right of C. Only one person sits between B and D. F sits third to the left of D. E sits at one of the positions to the right of G.

How many people sit between A and G?
solution:
**Given Conditions:**

→ A sits second from one of the extreme ends.

→ Only two people sit between A and C.

→ B sits to the immediate right of C.

→ Only one person sits between B and D.

→ F sits third to the left of D.

→ E sits to the right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1efff95ed8f62cb8122da09cf98e630442aada68e015a3cd5188f8bcae9ded2.png] 

A is at position 2 and G is at position 3.

No person sits between A and G.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4 - None".**
